name: Kashiwagi Narumi
source: One of the "empresses" of the school and the student council president as decided by a close vote between her and Shiina faction. The heiress to Mitaka Cosmetics, a multi-national company. Collected and composed, her reputation is sterling with her influence extending from both students and teachers alike. A model student who upholds school laws with the highest integrity.  Is also skilled with the blade.
